findings.text: tests/acceptance/tickets.test.js line 120 (assertion at line 126) fails every correct product; it reads the word ticket anywhere on an ignored-overlay fault line, and the overlay planted at the core path tools/ticket.py must be named on exactly such a line (overlay-health.test.js lines 8 to 13 and 50 to 55); the meaning stands (no offer on a fault's own line), the mechanism is the test-author's to correct

core/lib/squire.py line 601 accepts a version that is not three whole numbers; its pattern takes any Unicode decimal digit, leading zeros and a final newline, so a signed release whose version carries an Arabic-Indic digit, or ends in a newline, is staged and offered (core/tools/update.py lines 269 and 442), and the floor's install value at core/hooks/pre-tool-use.py line 324 lets the yes through; a signed release whose version carries an Arabic-Indic digit installed on a yes and became the current release; such a version must be refused as an unsigned release is, before anything is staged
